body:
A small cat stands before you, its eyes bright with energy and its zigzag mix of gray, white, and yellow fur standing on end.

Lightning Cat Hero

CR 3

XP 800
N Small magical beast
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 15, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +5 natural, +1 size)
hp 16 (3d10); fast healing 2
Fort +1, Ref +7, Will +3
Defensive Abilities elemental body; Immune electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., stormwalk
Melee bite +7 (1d4 plus 1d6 electricity), 2 claws +8 (1d3 plus 1d6 electricity)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 3rd; concentration +5)

At Will—flare (DC 12), light (self only)
1/hour—hold person (DC 14)
3/day—magic missile

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 19, Con 10, Int 10, Wis 11, Cha 15
Base Atk +3; CMB +2; CMD 13 (17 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse
Skills Escape Artist +10, Fly +7 (+15 with stormwalk), Intimidate +6, Perception +5, Stealth +8
Languages understands Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Elemental Body (Ex)

Each time a lightning cat is exposed to a poison, paralysis, sleep, or stunning effect, it has a 25% chance to avoid it. In addition, there is a 25% chance that a sneak attack or critical hit deals no extra damage.

Stormwalk (Su)

Lightning cats can fly with perfect maneuverability when flying through rain or lightning. They can also walk on air as though via the air walk spell during a rainstorm.
